author: NPR Music
description:
Coming soon: Dead After Death! Starting on August 1, NPR Music will publish a week-long special series of stories and podcast episodes exploring the legacy and future of the Grateful Dead fandom. ☮️⁠
⁠
First, we want to hear from you! Head to npr.org/music and let us know how you became a Deadhead. 🔗
title: Coming soon: Dead After Death! Exploring the legacy and future of the Grateful Dead fandom.
